source.detail: digitized: Yang et al. 2016 (doi:10.1002/admt.201600055) Fig 2A quasi-static free contraction vs vacuum + Fig 2D hung-weight loading at dP 90 kPa, Ecoflex 00-30

metadata.notes: DRAFT -- not reviewed, not in the manifest. Vacuum-actuated muscle-inspired pneumatic actuator (VAMP) cast in Ecoflex 00-30 (E = 43 kPa, paper text): an elastomer block of 34 x 28 x 46.5 mm with rows of internal cavities whose beams buckle under vacuum, so the actuator contracts along its length. Input: the paper's differential pressure dP = P_ext - P_int; stored as u = -dP (Pa, negative gauge pressure, as the abboodi2026 vacuum-contract record). Free motion: Fig 2A, no load, mean of n = 7 samples; tip displacement = L(dP,0) - L(0,0) read off the figure's top axis (mm), along -X (frame X base->tip; the base is taken as fixed and the free end as the tip). The first level is the digitised rest point as read, not forced to zero. free_direction is the first level that moves more than 2% of the stroke. Blocked force: none. The paper quotes no blocked force for these devices. Fig 2D hangs weights T on the actuator at dP = 90 kPa (Fig 2 caption) and reports the actuation strain (L(dP,T) - L(0,T))/L(0,0) (paper Eq 3), measured from the length under the same load with no vacuum, not from the rest length; the passive stretch L(0,T) - L(0,0) is not given in this copy (the SI is missing). So no point of Fig 2D has the tip held at its rest position, and blocked is left null. At the heaviest load, T = 0.981 N, the actuation strain is -0.0007, zero within SD plus reading error (0.0167): this is the largest load the vacuum can still lift at 90 kPa (the text, printed page 7, calls it the maximum loading stress). It is not the force with the tip held at rest length, which is likely lower. The load-strain curve (CSV yang2016_fig2D_load_ecoflex.csv) has no place in schema v0.2 and is kept in the CSV only. Reading error (yang2016_fig2_reading_error.json): about 0.065 mm on displacement and 0.0131 kPa on dP; 0.0038 N on load. The paper's SD between samples (CSV column strain_sd) is larger. No stiffness data.
